name: Enginemailer

evidence.transactional: F02: application-generated transactional messages through the REST sending API

line: Send newsletters, automated campaigns, and transactional email from one service.

cells.api: Yes, REST API; SMTP not documented

subs.math: 4,000 emails a month fit the 10,000 monthly quota, as long as they are staged at no more than 500 a day.
$9 base, plus 8,000 extra emails at $0.00085 each = $15.80 a month.
$9 base, plus 28,000 extra emails at $0.00085 each = $32.80 a month.
$49 base, plus 125,000 extra emails at $0.00070 each = $136.50 a month.

appmail.math: 3,000 emails a month fit inside the monthly quota and the 500-a-day limit, when spread across the month.
10,000 emails a month fit the monthly quota, when sent over at least 20 days at 500 a day.
$9 base, plus 38,000 extra emails at $0.00085 each = $41.30 a month.
$49 base, plus 25,000 extra emails at $0.00070 each = $66.50 a month.
